steps.goal: Scaffold pi-native .pi/mcp.json with F10/F11/F11a merge semantics, and retire the fork-era .mcp.json reader claim
steps.instructions:
TDD end to end (failing test first, paste RED output). You own the scaffolder's MCP write path. Context you must verify before fixing: research record docs/work/2026-09-30-aib-scaffold-pi-native-mcp-config-research.md (F1-F11a) at the repo root you were given. Also report, per test, one plausible code mutation it would NOT catch (anti-tautology discipline).

What to build, in features/common/skills/welcome-ai-badger/scripts/mcp_tools.py + scripts/scaffold.py (call site scaffold.py:744-749):
1. A new McpDestination writing .pi/mcp.json (label '.pi/mcp.json', readers=('pi',), requires_reader=True: written only when 'pi' is in config.agents; only project-scoped servers, exactly like generate_mcp_json splits scope). Reuse the _merge_mcp_servers_json machinery where compatible, but the pi destination's merge semantics are F10/F11/F11a (below) and override the usual section.update(entries) rewrite.
2. New-entry template shape (F4/F8): base declarations are SHELL STRINGS ('uv run --script ...', 'code-review-graph serve', 'npx -y @playwright/mcp@latest') — pi requires a single executable + args, so split via the existing split_on_whitespace/_render_entry path (it already splits when 'args' is absent — pin this for the pi destination). Cover ALL THREE declaration shapes in tests: multiword command, single-word command, and an explicit-'args' declaration that must NOT be re-split. User-tool-dir executables render in ~/-form (~/... prefix — pi expands ~ in command/args/cwd only; ${HOME} stays literal and must never be emitted). The AI_BADGER_MCP_AVAILABILITY determinism override must gate the ~ rewrite exactly as it gates the ${HOME} one (_home_relative_command) — test BOTH override states. Drop the fork 'tools' array (all_tools=False). Add "exposure": "direct" on every NEW entry (hardcoded destination default — the schema forbids a per-server exposure key). Never carry the claude agentOverride's ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR} anchor: resolve agentOverrides for the destination's own reader ('pi') so the base, unanchored declaration renders.
3. Merge semantics (F10/F11/F11a — the acceptance contract): (a) an entry already present in .pi/mcp.json survives re-scaffold BYTE-IDENTICAL at entry level (whole entry — template shape governs new entries only; when today's template would render differently, emit a template-drift note, never rewrite); (b) new declared servers are appended with the template; (c) entries the scaffold does not recognize (user-added servers) survive untouched — merge is a union, never a drop; (d) config.mcp.decline still removes its named servers, with a declined-removal note (#186); (e) the unavailable-removal path keeps its shape gate, where shape = template identity (command/args/env/cwd as rendered) and decorations (exposure/toolExposure/enabled and any unknown key) neither shield a template-identical entry from removal nor count toward identity — a tuned-but-dead server is removed with a note; (f) a hand-edited launch (not template-identical) is a user edit: kept with a warn-and-leave note, never destroyed. Build the removal comparison template through the SAME home-rewrite path the write uses, or ~-form entries never match and linger. Fixture requirements beyond (a)-(f): one fixture pinning the sibling's REFERENCE STATE deep-equal survival — 5 servers, 3 'direct' (ai-raccoon, task-graph, semantica) + 2 'deferred' (code-review-graph, playwright) with a toolExposure map and an unknown user key, all surviving unchanged (a mutation that preserves exposure but drops toolExposure or an unknown key must fail); identity-dimension variants of (f) editing args, env, and adding cwd — each kept with the hand-edit note; and note-presence assertions for all three notes (declined-removal, template-drift, hand-edit). Entry-level identity is the ruling (writer re-serialization indent=2 is accepted); pin it with a second same-writer render leaving file bytes unchanged.
4. Retire the fork-era claim (F2) IN mcp_tools.py: remove 'pi' from MCP_JSON.readers and the EXPANDS_HOME_ONLY fork carve-out (or leave the mechanism inert if removing it churns more than it cleans — your call, say which; if it stays inert, correct the comments at mcp_tools.py:74-81, 128-132, 397-410 to say so explicitly). Scope the honesty claim to mcp_tools.py only — adjust_mcp.py's fork claims belong to the separate H3 retirement. Consequence (documented behavior change — report its sentence for s4's changelog): with claude+pi configured, .mcp.json goes back to Claude's ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR} anchor and the fork-era 'dropped for pi' note disappears. Replace the fork-era tests (test_mcp_json_carries_the_project_relative_launch_when_pi_is_configured and siblings) with test_mcp_json_keeps_claudes_anchor_with_pi_configured.
5. Record every .pi/mcp.json write through ctx.record_generated_config (generatedConfig manifest, #194) and note the trust gate once per run (pi reads .pi/mcp.json only in trusted projects; headless with defaultProjectTrust ask|never skips it).

Test list (tests/test_stack_mcp_servers.py — NAMING CONVENTION IS BINDING: pi-render tests start with pi_mcp_json_, merge/semantic tests with pi_native_, so the AC selectors cannot silently match a subset): test_pi_mcp_json_written_for_pi_agent; test_pi_mcp_json_not_created_without_pi_agent; test_pi_mcp_json_splits_shell_string_command (all three declaration shapes); test_pi_mcp_json_uses_tilde_home_form_not_dollar_home (both AI_BADGER_MCP_AVAILABILITY states); test_pi_mcp_json_carries_no_tools_array; test_pi_mcp_json_new_entries_default_to_direct_exposure; test_pi_mcp_json_inherits_no_claude_anchor; test_mcp_json_keeps_claudes_anchor_with_pi_configured; test_pi_native_existing_entry_survives_scaffold_byte_identical; test_pi_native_reference_state_survives_deep_equal (the 3-direct+2-deferred fixture); test_pi_native_new_entry_gets_template; test_pi_native_unknown_entry_survives; test_pi_native_declined_server_removed (with note); test_pi_native_unavailable_tuned_entry_removed (decorations do not shield); test_pi_native_unavailable_hand_edited_entry_kept_with_note (args/env/cwd variants); test_pi_native_second_render_leaves_file_bytes_unchanged; test_pi_native_template_drift_noted_not_applied; test_pi_mcp_json_records_generated_config. Prefer extending the existing _render_everywhere/_SPLIT_CASES parametrization so pi is covered by the existing split/cwd/env cases; if the ~ work must change USER_TOOL_DIRS or _home_relative_command's shape, tests/test_mcp_user_tool_paths.py joins your files (it monkeypatches USER_TOOL_DIRS) — otherwise leave it alone.

Fold-verification additions: (6) SELF-SCAFFOLD (MUST 1): after the code lands, run the self-scaffold refresh per the task-context SELF-SCAFFOLD DISCIPLINE and commit the regenerated .ai-badger/ outputs and .pi/mcp.json (this repo's config lists the pi agent, so the new writer produces it here) — gates/scaffold_freshness_guard.py must pass on your tree.
